en.name: Sweet chilli sauce
en.summary: Sweet chilli sauce is sugar plus vinegar plus salt — the same acid-and-sugar barrier that keeps ketchup stable. Unopened bottles keep about 12 months in a cool dark cupboard. Refrigerated after opening it holds about 6 months, and the label's advice to refrigerate is about quality rather than safety.
en.pantry: Unopened bottles keep about 12 months from purchase in a cool dark cupboard. As with other shelf-stable chilli sauces, the sauce stays safe at room temperature after opening, and quality, not safety, is the reason the label suggests refrigerating it. That said, a sweet sauce in a warm kitchen dulls quickly: the bright red goes brown and the fresh chilli note flattens into simple sweetness. Keep bottles out of sunlight and away from the hob, and stand them upright so the cap does not glue itself shut.
en.fridge: Refrigerate after opening at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for the best colour and flavour, about 6 months. Wipe the neck of the bottle after every pour — sugary drips on the thread are where mould starts, and they are also what makes the cap stick. Decant into a small dipping dish rather than letting people dip into the bottle, and never return sauce from a dish to the bottle.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for sweet chilli sauce and there is no reason to freeze it. Sugar, vinegar and salt already keep it for months, and freezing a syrupy sauce only crystallises the sugar and clouds it. If a bottle is outliving your appetite for it, use it more freely — it works as a glaze for chicken and salmon, not only as a dip.
spoilage: Mould around the neck, the cap or on the surface
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
Fizzing or hissing when the bottle is opened
Colour gone brown with the chilli flecks faded and the taste merely sweet
tips: Pour into a dipping dish; never let people dip straight into the bottle.
Wipe the neck after every pour so the cap does not stick.
Keep it out of sunlight — a red sauce browns fast on a bright shelf.
For a sauce you want to taste its best, treat the shorter end of its window as the real target; some pantry guidance gives opened chilli sauce far less than this.

faq.q: Does sweet chilli sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Not for safety — a shelf-stable bottle is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps the colour and flavour much better.

faq.q: How long does sweet chilli sauce last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 6 months after opening at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle keep?
faq.a: About 12 months in a cool dark cupboard.

faq.q: Can you freeze sweet chilli sauce?
faq.a: There is no timeline and no reason to. It keeps for months on its own and freezing crystallises the sugar.

zh.name: 泰式甜辣醬
zh.summary: 泰式甜辣醬是糖加醋加鹽——和讓番茄醬穩定的酸糖屏障完全相同。未開封的瓶裝放陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。開封後冷藏大約 6 個月，而標籤建議冷藏，講的是品質而不是安全。
zh.pantry: 未開封的瓶子放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 12 個月。和其他常溫販售的辣醬一樣，開封後放室溫仍然是安全的，標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全。不過，甜味醬料在溫暖的廚房裡走鈍得很快：鮮紅會轉褐，新鮮辣椒的香氣會扁平成單純的甜。請避免日曬、遠離爐火，並直立擺放，免得瓶蓋黏死。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，顏色和風味都最好，大約 6 個月。每次倒完都擦瓶口——螺紋上的糖漬正是發霉的起點，也是瓶蓋黏住的原因。請倒到沾醬碟裡，不要讓大家直接沾瓶子，碟子裡剩下的也絕對不要倒回去。
zh.freezer: 泰式甜辣醬沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。糖、醋和鹽本來就能讓它放好幾個月，而冷凍一瓶濃稠的糖醬只會讓糖結晶、液體變濁。一瓶老是用不完的話，就放手多用一點——它除了當沾醬，刷在雞肉或鮭魚上當上色醬汁也很好。
spoilage: 聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
顏色轉褐、辣椒碎褪色，吃起來只剩甜味
tips: 倒到沾醬碟；不要讓大家直接沾瓶口。
每次倒完擦瓶口，免得瓶蓋黏死。
避免日曬——紅色醬料在亮處很快變褐。
想吃到最好的風味，就把窗口較短的那一端當成實際目標；有些櫥櫃保存指引給開封辣醬的時間比這短得多。

faq.q: 泰式甜辣醬開封後一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 以安全來說不用——常溫販售的瓶裝開封後放室溫仍然安全。但冷藏能讓顏色和風味好很多。

faq.q: 泰式甜辣醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 6 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的甜辣醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。

faq.q: 泰式甜辣醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有對應期限，也沒有理由。它本來就能放好幾個月，冷凍只會讓糖結晶。
